current_interpretation: The draft treats NODI codes as requiring interpretation and does not assign meaning to any nonempty code. For FY2025 measurements without a reported numeric value (empty DMR_VALUE_NMBR), it materializes no_numeric_result_case rows carrying the raw nodi_code field but lists only empty string as a known interpretation. Codes C (150 rows) and 9 (36 rows) are therefore left unresolved; the draft does not classify them as no discharge, not required, or any other missing-evidence state.
why_it_matters: Purpose C must distinguish documented no-discharge periods, conditionally waived monitoring, other documented no-data states, and cases where required monitoring appears to lack evidence. Without interpreting NODI codes, 186 FY2025 no-result cases cannot be classified and missing data cannot be treated as compliance or violation.
supporting_evidence_used: ISSUES.md: 186 uninterpreted NODI cases; dmr_measurements.csv NODI_CODE; empty DMR_VALUE_NMBR on these rows
alternatives_considered: Treat code C as establishing no discharge for the monitoring period
Treat code 9 as establishing monitoring was not required
Treat C and 9 as interchangeable synonyms for the same missing-evidence state
Leave all nonempty NODI codes unresolved until domain interpretation is supplied (current draft choice)
remaining_uncertainty: What C vs 9 establish for missing-evidence classification; whether they are interchangeable.
